valuation.rationale: Downside valuation takes the downside forecast earnings of {{FIG:ebitda_down_fy26|US$ m}} at a lower multiple for a weaker, higher-rate business.
valuation.limitation: The multiple is an analyst assumption without a market source.

valuation.label: Stress
valuation.rationale: Stress valuation keeps the downside earnings of {{FIG:ebitda_down_fy26|US$ m}} and cuts the multiple to a distressed level.
valuation.limitation: The multiple is an analyst assumption without a market source.

fulcrum.rationale: Every creditor class is paid in full, so equity is the first class that does not receive a full claim.
Value runs out among the unsecured operating creditors, who share equally.
Value runs out at the secured term loan, so it is the fulcrum class.

plan.rationale: All creditors are unimpaired and equity keeps the residual.
plan.limitation: Plan treatment is an analyst judgment, not a plan document.

plan.rationale: The unsecured creditors take the reorganised equity and the old equity is cancelled.
plan.limitation: Plan treatment is an analyst judgment, not a plan document.

plan.rationale: The term loan lenders take the reorganised equity and all junior classes are cancelled.
plan.limitation: Plan treatment is an analyst judgment, not a plan document.

assessment.rationale: Against the term loan of {{FIG:total_debt_ltm|US$ m}}, the base valuation pays every creditor, while the downside valuation breaks value among the unsecured creditors and the stress valuation breaks it at the term loan.
assessment.limitation: Multiples, ranks and plan treatment are analyst assumptions without a source citation.

gaps.why_it_matters: Recovery of the secured class rests on the whole distributable value, not on collateral.
